shaderContract.baseColor: preserve runtime tint; no genetics changes
shaderContract.recommendedBake: decode existing sRGB to linear; treat study gray as raw data, neutral 128; multiply by 1+strength*manualMask*(gray-128)/128, preserve alpha, check clipping and seam; not implemented here

checks: 256 periodic samples per study, wrap edge differences, neutral mean, range 84..172, PNG stored scanline roundtrip, deterministic bytes
limitations: Not real UV mapped dragon textures; no actual model decode, bake, render, external PNG decoder, Blender, Unity or Android. Do not use as Normal or PBR map. Proposed strengths need visual approval.
